patch.summary:
Thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.

Same category, different company size. Choose Ecwid only if your buying job matches “Embeddable storefront you add to an existing site — Starter $5/mo, Venture $29 annual, Bus” rather than VTEX's shape. Choose VTEX only if your buying job matches “Enterprise commerce SaaS — contact-sales get-started only; no invented floors. Shopify kee” rather than Ecwid's shape. Workflow advantage: Ecwid leans checkout-conversion; VTEX leans wholesale-b2b. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.
- Positioning: Ecwid is Embeddable storefront you add to an existing site — Starter $5/mo, Venture $29 annual, Business $49, Unlimited $119 (post 2 Mar 2026 tiles);; VTEX is Enterprise commerce SaaS — contact-sales get-started only; no invented floors. Shopify keeps the SaaS award..
- Company-size focus: Ecwid (solo, micro, small-business) vs VTEX (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Ecwid-leaning checkout-conversion vs VTEX-leaning wholesale-b2b.
- Researched limits: Ecwid — Catalog, B2B, and checkout depth trail Shopify-class commerce OS products; VTEX — No published self-serve monthly tiles — hard to shortlist on list price alone.

Limitations — Ecwid: Catalog, B2B, and checkout depth trail Shopify-class commerce OS products; POS / omnichannel is limited versus Lightspeed Retail or Square; VTEX: No published self-serve monthly tiles — hard to shortlist on list price alone; Enterprise sales and implementation cycles versus Shopify SMB speed.

Poor-fit cases: Ecwid is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Catalog, B2B, and checkout depth trail Shopify-class commerce OS products · VTEX is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published self-serve monthly tiles — hard to shortlist on list price alone · Avoid Ecwid if you actually need VTEX's motion (Enterprise commerce SaaS — contact-sales get-started only; no invented floors. S)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
